description: CUDA 全链路验收基线  c99f559 refactor: training orchestration into stage modules
environment: RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (6GB), CUDA 12.1, PyTorch 2.5.1+cu121, WSL2 Linux
notes: eval_mse  lower-is-better: candidate = baseline + tolerance 内为通过
eval_corr  higher-is-better: candidate = baseline - tolerance 内为通过
eval_dice  higher-is-better: candidate = baseline - tolerance 内为通过
eval_sat  lower-is-better: candidate = baseline + tolerance 内为通过
eval_slm_tv  lower-is-better: candidate = baseline + tolerance 内为通过
sample_corr  higher-is-better: candidate = baseline - tolerance 内为通过
sample_dice  higher-is-better: candidate = baseline - tolerance 内为通过
best_loss  lower-is-better: candidate = baseline + tolerance 内为通过
阈值优先使用本文件 tolerances，其次使用 eval_reports._DEFAULT_TOLERANCES
compare 时多个 run dir 的指标按 best-of 合并（lower-is-better 取 min，higher-is-better 取 max）
